name: 3 Days Queen Elizabeth National Park Safari
summary: Experience the wild heart of Uganda in Queen Elizabeth National Park – home to tree-climbing lions, massive hippo pods, savannah elephants, and over 600 bird species. This 3-day adventure balances game drives, a scenic Kazinga Channel boat cruise, and golden savannah sunsets.
highlights: Morning & afternoon game drives in the Kasenyi Plains
Kazinga Channel boat cruise – spot hippos, crocodiles & waterbirds
Look for Uganda's famous tree-climbing lions in Ishasha sector
Over 600 bird species including the rare shoebill stork
Sundowner views over the Rwenzori Mountains
included: Private 4x4 safari vehicle with pop-up roof

itinerary.title: Kampala – Queen Elizabeth National Park
itinerary.description: Early morning departure from Kampala heading southwest through the beautiful Uganda countryside. Afternoon game drive in the Kasenyi Plains, famous for large lion prides. Check-in at your lodge with stunning savannah views.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drives & Kazinga Channel Cruise
itinerary.description: Morning game drive to see lions, elephants, buffalos, and hippos. After breakfast return to the lodge. At midday, embark on a 2-hour boat cruise on the Kazinga Channel — the world's most densely populated waterway for hippos and water birds. Evening game drive to the Ishasha sector to spot the rare tree-climbing lions.

itinerary.title: Morning Game Drive & Return to Kampala
itinerary.description: Final morning game drive with golden sunrise light. After brunch, depart for Kampala arriving in the evening. 3 days of pure Ugandan safari magic.

name: 2 Days Gorilla Tracking – Kigali to Bwindi
summary: A perfectly crafted 2-day gorilla trek combining the convenience of flying into Kigali, Rwanda, with the breathtaking wilderness of Bwindi Impenetrable Forest in Uganda. Come face-to-face with habituated mountain gorilla families in their misty jungle home.
highlights: Encounter habituated mountain gorilla families in Bwindi
Convenient fly-in from Kigali, Rwanda
UNESCO World Heritage Forest experience
Expert gorilla guides and trackers
1 magical hour with a gorilla family in the wild

itinerary.title: Kigali Arrival – Transfer to Bwindi
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kigali International Airport. Meet your guide for the scenic drive through Rwanda's terraced hillsides and across the Rwanda-Uganda border into Bwindi. Evening briefing with your gorilla guide about tomorrow's trek. Dinner and overnight at your Bwindi forest lodge.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking – Return to Kigali
itinerary.description: Early breakfast then set off for the most thrilling wildlife experience on Earth. Trek through Bwindi's ancient forest with expert guides and trackers. Spend one unforgettable hour with a habituated mountain gorilla family. Certificates awarded. Return to Kigali, arriving evening.

name: 2 Days Chimpanzee Tracking at Kibale
summary: Kibale National Park is East Africa's premier primate destination — home to 1,500 chimpanzees and 12 other primate species. Immerse yourself in lush tropical forest tracking wild chimpanzees with expert naturalist guides.
highlights: Track habituated chimpanzees in Kibale Forest
12 primate species including red colobus and L'Hoest's monkeys
Bigodi Wetland Sanctuary walk
Expert naturalist guides throughout
Tea plantation country scenery drive from Kampala

itinerary.title: Kampala – Kibale National Park
itinerary.description: Morning departure from Kampala heading west through Fort Portal, a scenic town cradled between the Rwenzori Mountains and crater lakes. Stop for lunch on route. Afternoon arrival at Kibale. Evening briefing with your naturalist guide.

itinerary.title: Chimpanzee Tracking – Bigodi Wetland – Kampala
itinerary.description: Early morning start into the forest for chimpanzee tracking. Follow expert trackers through the dense jungle canopy listening for the chimpanzees' distinctive calls. After tracking, enjoy a guided walk through Bigodi Wetland Sanctuary. Return to Kampala in the afternoon.

name: 3 Days Murchison Falls Safari
summary: Murchison Falls is Uganda's largest national park and one of Africa's greatest wildlife theatres — where the Nile explodes through a 7-metre rock gap creating the world's most powerful waterfall. Game drives, boat cruises and the falls top viewpoint all await.
highlights: Game drives spotting lions, elephants, giraffes, and buffalos
Nile River boat cruise to the base of Murchison Falls
Top of the falls viewpoint hike
Morning birding (470+ species)
Chimp tracking at Kaniyo Pabidi (optional add-on)

itinerary.title: Kampala – Murchison Falls National Park
itinerary.description: Early morning departure heading north through Kampala suburbs and into the open savannah. Afternoon game drive spotting Uganda's largest concentration of giraffe, elephants, lions, and Nile crocodiles. Sunset at the river bank before dinner at your lodge.

itinerary.title: Game Drive, Nile Cruise & Falls Viewpoint
itinerary.description: Dawn game drive through the parklands. After breakfast, a spectacular 2-hour boat cruise up the Nile River to the base of Murchison Falls. Afternoon hike to the top of the falls for breathtaking views of the Nile squeezing through the rock gap. Evening game drive.

itinerary.title: Morning Game Drive – Return to Kampala
itinerary.description: Final morning game drive with the chance to spot leopards and lions. After brunch, drive back to Kampala arriving in the evening. A safari of unsurpassed natural drama.

name: 5 Days Gorilla Trekking & Lake Bunyonyi
summary: An exceptional 5-day Uganda safari combining the world's greatest wildlife encounter — mountain gorilla trekking in Bwindi — with a relaxing finale on the stunning terraced shores of Lake Bunyonyi, Africa's second deepest lake.
highlights: Mountain gorilla trekking in Bwindi Impenetrable Forest
Relaxing stay on the shores of Lake Bunyonyi
Canoe exploration of Bunyonyi's 29 islands
Batwa cultural experience and forest walk
Scenic drive through Uganda's beautiful southwest

itinerary.title: Kampala – Bwindi
itinerary.description: Scenic 8-hour drive through Uganda's rolling hills, stopping at the equator and in Kabale town. Arrive Bwindi for dinner and overnight at forest lodge.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi
itinerary.description: The main event — trek into Bwindi's ancient primeval forest guided by expert trackers to find your assigned gorilla family. One hour of pure magic face-to-face with mountain gorillas. Afternoon rest and debrief.

itinerary.title: Batwa Cultural Experience
itinerary.description: Morning: guided half-day experience with the Batwa people, the original 'keepers' of the Bwindi Forest. Learn traditional forest survival skills, music, and storytelling. Afternoon drive to Lake Bunyonyi.

itinerary.title: Lake Bunyonyi – Island Exploration
itinerary.description: Full relaxing day on Africa's second deepest lake. Canoe between Bunyonyi's 29 islands. Visit Punishment Island with its remarkable history. Sunset from the lakeside terrace.

itinerary.title: Lake Bunyonyi – Kampala
itinerary.description: Morning canoe sunrise paddle. After breakfast, scenic drive back to Kampala arriving in the late afternoon. End of an unforgettable 5-day Uganda adventure.

name: 3 Days Queen Elizabeth & Kazinga Channel Cruise
summary: A tailor-made safari focused on the world-famous Kazinga Channel boat cruise at Queen Elizabeth National Park — where the wildlife density along the riverbanks is exceptional: hundreds of hippos, Nile crocodiles, elephants drinking at the water's edge, and 600+ bird species.
highlights: Extended Kazinga Channel boat cruise with maximum wildlife viewing
Hundreds of hippos and Nile crocodiles at close range
Exceptional birdwatching — 600+ species including shoebill
Game drives in Kasenyi Plains for lions and elephants
Sunset over the Kazinga Channel

itinerary.title: Kampala – Queen Elizabeth National Park
itinerary.description: Early morning drive southwest. Arrival by early afternoon for a game drive. Check in and sunset cocktails overlooking the Channel.

itinerary.title: Extended Kazinga Channel Cruise & Game Drives
itinerary.description: Full morning game drive targeting the famous tree-climbing lions in Ishasha. Extended Kazinga Channel cruise in the afternoon — your naturalist guide will identify hundreds of species including the elusive shoebill stork.

itinerary.title: Morning Game Drive & Return
itinerary.description: Final dawn game drive. Brunch before the scenic drive back to Kampala.

name: 22 Days Complete Uganda Cultural Circuit
summary: The ultimate Uganda experience — a complete 22-day circuit visiting every cultural region of the country. Northern plains, Eastern highlands, Western crater lakes, and Southern forests — all Uganda's greatest wildlife and cultural treasures in one epic journey.
highlights: Gorilla trekking in Bwindi Impenetrable Forest
Chimpanzee tracking in Kibale Forest
Game drives in Queen Elizabeth, Murchison Falls & Kidepo
Cultural visits to Buganda, Ankole, Karamoja kingdoms
Jinja - Source of the Nile & whitewater rafting
Sipi Falls & Mount Elgon trekking

itinerary.title: Arrival – Kampala
itinerary.description: Airport meet and greet. Transfer to your Kampala hotel. Welcome dinner and trip briefing.

itinerary.title: Kampala City Tour
itinerary.description: Full day city tour of Uganda's vibrant capital. Kasubi Royal Tombs, Namirembe Cathedral, craft markets, and traditional food.

itinerary.title: Kampala – Jinja (Source of the Nile)
itinerary.description: Drive east to Jinja. Boat trip to the Source of the Nile. Optional whitewater rafting (Grade 5).

itinerary.title: Sipi Falls – Mount Elgon
itinerary.description: Drive to Sipi Falls for a spectacular three-tiered waterfall hike. Cultural encounter with the Bagisu people.

itinerary.title: Kidepo Valley National Park (fly)
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Kidepo — Africa's most remote and dramatic national park. Afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Kidepo – Full Day Game Drives
itinerary.description: Full day exploring Kidepo's vast wilderness. Cheetahs, ostriches, Karamoja giraffes and Rothschild giraffes.

itinerary.title: Kidepo – Murchison Falls (scenic drive)
itinerary.description: Drive southwest through Northern Uganda passing through Gulu and Karuma Falls.

itinerary.title: Murchison Falls – Game Drive
itinerary.description: Morning game drive. Afternoon Nile boat cruise to Murchison Falls base.

itinerary.title: Murchison Falls – Falls Top Hike
itinerary.description: Hike to top of the falls. Afternoon game drive. Optional chimp tracking at Kaniyo Pabidi.

itinerary.title: Fort Portal – Kibale Forest
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to Fort Portal via Budongo Forest. Arrival at Kibale.

name: 4 Days Mount Kenya Trekking
summary: Mount Kenya (5,199m) is Africa's second highest peak and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Trek through equatorial forests, giant heather zones and glacial valleys to reach Point Lenana at 4,985m — a life-changing high-altitude adventure.
highlights: Summit Point Lenana (4,985m) at sunrise
Trek through unique Afro-alpine vegetation zones
Glacier views and stunning equatorial mountain scenery
Rich wildlife: elephant, buffalo, colobus monkey
Certified high-altitude guides throughout

itinerary.title: Nairobi – Sirimon Gate – Old Moses Camp (3,300m)
itinerary.description: Drive north from Nairobi to Sirimon Gate. Begin trekking through Afro-montane forest. Arrive at Old Moses Camp for dinner and first night at altitude.

itinerary.title: Old Moses Camp – Shipton's Camp (4,200m)
itinerary.description: Acclimatisation day. Ascending through heather moorland and giant lobelia. Arrive Shipton's Camp with stunning views of Batian and Nelion peaks.

itinerary.title: Summit Push – Point Lenana (4,985m)
itinerary.description: Early 3am wake up. Summit push to Point Lenana arriving for spectacular sunrise. Descend via Chogoria route through the dramatic Gorges Valley.

itinerary.title: Descent – Nairobi
itinerary.description: Complete descent to Chogoria Gate. Transfer back to Nairobi for drinks and debrief celebration.

name: 7 Days Mount Kilimanjaro Climbing
summary: Conquer Africa's highest peak — Mount Kilimanjaro (5,895m) — on the scenic Machame Route, known as the 'Whiskey Route' for its dramatic scenery. A life-changing 7-day ascent through five distinct climate zones to the Roof of Africa.
highlights: Summit Uhuru Peak (5,895m) — the Roof of Africa
Machame Route — most scenic Kilimanjaro route
Five distinct climate zones: rainforest to arctic
Exceptional summit success rate with acclimatisation profile
Certified KPAP-compliant local guides and porter team
included: All meals on the mountain (full board)

itinerary.title: Arusha – Machame Gate – Machame Camp (3,000m)
itinerary.description: Transfer from Arusha to Machame Gate. Trek through dense rainforest alive with colobus monkeys. Arrive Machame Camp for first night on the mountain.

itinerary.title: Machame Camp – Shira Camp (3,850m)
itinerary.description: Emerge above the treeline into moorland plateau. Stunning views of Kibo summit. Arrive Shira Camp.

itinerary.title: Shira Camp – Lava Tower – Barranco Camp
itinerary.description: Acclimatisation day climbing to Lava Tower (4,600m) then descending to Barranco Camp (3,950m) — a classic 'climb high, sleep low' acclimatisation strategy.

itinerary.title: Barranco Camp – Barafu Camp (4,550m)
itinerary.description: The famous Barranco Wall scramble — thrilling exposed ridge climbing. Continue through the alpine desert to Barafu Camp, the launch pad for summit night.

itinerary.title: Summit Night – Uhuru Peak (5,895m)
itinerary.description: Midnight departure under the stars. Ascent through Stella Point (5,756m) to Uhuru Peak at sunrise. Descend to Mweka Camp. Your greatest achievement.

itinerary.title: Mweka Camp – Mweka Gate
itinerary.description: Final descent through rainforest collecting your summit certificate at Mweka Gate.

itinerary.title: Arusha – Depart
itinerary.description: Transfer back to Arusha hotel. Celebration dinner and debrief. Certificate presentation ceremony.

name: 7 Days Western Uganda Cultural Tour
summary: Explore the rich cultural tapestry of western Uganda — from the ancient kingdoms of Ankole and Bunyoro to the vibrant Bwindi Batwa community and the stunning crater lakes of Fort Portal. A soul-enriching journey through Uganda's most culturally diverse region.
highlights: Ankole cultural experience with the famous long-horned cattle
Bunyoro kingdom and ancient royal palaces
Batwa forest community experience near Bwindi
Fort Portal crater lakes canoe trip
Traditional Ugandan cuisine cooking class

itinerary.title: Kampala – Mbarara – Ankole
itinerary.description: Drive south-west to Ankole region. Visit Ankole Cultural Centre and meet the legendary long-horned Ankole cattle. Evening cultural performance.

itinerary.title: Ankole – Ibanda – Crater Lakes
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Ibanda district cultural sites. Afternoon drive through the dramatic Fort Portal crater lake region.

itinerary.title: Fort Portal – Kibale Forest Edges
itinerary.description: Explore the extraordinary crater lake landscape on foot and by canoe. Birding along the lakeshores.

itinerary.title: Kibale – Bwindi (Cultural Day)
itinerary.description: Drive to Bwindi. Afternoon Batwa cultural experience — the original forest people of Bwindi share their heritage, traditions, and forest knowledge.

itinerary.title: Bwindi – Bunyoro Kingdom
itinerary.description: Drive north through the green Uganda highlands. Visit the Bunyoro-Kitara Kingdom palace and museum.

itinerary.title: Bunyoro – Murchison Area
itinerary.description: Explore the Bunyoro cultural heartland. Traditional food experience and local market visit.

itinerary.title: Return to Kampala
itinerary.description: Scenic morning drive back to Kampala through the rolling Ugandan countryside. Evening farewell dinner.

name: 8 Days Rwenzori Mountain Trekking – Margherita Peak
summary: The Rwenzori Mountains — the mythical Mountains of the Moon — are one of Africa's most coveted and challenging trekking destinations. Summit Margherita Peak (5,109m), the third highest point in Africa, through alien Afro-alpine vegetation unlike anywhere on Earth.
highlights: Summit Margherita Peak (5,109m) — 3rd highest in Africa
Unique giant lobelia and groundsel Afro-alpine vegetation
Historic 'Mountains of the Moon' — the legendary source of the Nile
Glaciers and snowfields straddling the equator
UNESCO World Heritage Site trekking

itinerary.title: Fort Portal – Nyakalengija (Trailhead) – Sine Hut (2,600m)
itinerary.description: Drive from Fort Portal to Nyakalengija village at the park boundary. Begin trekking through cultivated land into montane forest. Arrive Sine Hut for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Sine Hut – Nyabitaba Hut (2,651m)
itinerary.description: Trek through dense montane forest alongside the Mubuku River. Spectacular forest birds and chance of forest elephant. Arrive Nyabitaba for night.

itinerary.title: Nyabitaba – John Matte Hut (3,414m)
itinerary.description: Cross the Bujuku River and ascend steeply through heather and moorland. First views of the snow-capped peaks. John Matte Hut tonight.

itinerary.title: John Matte – Bujuku Hut (3,962m)
itinerary.description: Trek through surreal giant senecio and lobelia forests. Arrive Bujuku Hut in the heart of the mountains with Margherita Peak dominating the skyline.

itinerary.title: Acclimatisation – Scott Elliot Pass (4,372m)
itinerary.description: Acclimatisation day — climb to Scott Elliot Pass for stunning views. Return to Bujuku for overnight.

itinerary.title: Summit Margherita Peak (5,109m)
itinerary.description: Early start for the technical summit ascent via Elena Hut and the glaciers. Summit Margherita Peak with views across Uganda and DRC. Descend to Kitandara Hut.

itinerary.title: Kitandara – Nyabitaba
itinerary.description: Long descent day through the spectacular Bujuku Valley and back down through montane forest.

itinerary.title: Nyabitaba – Nyakalengija – Fort Portal
itinerary.description: Final descent back to the trailhead. Transfer to Fort Portal for hot shower and celebration dinner. Certificates awarded.
